mapper.select: SELECT t.bus_no AS id, t.bus_no AS busNo, t.status_enum AS statusEnum, CASE t.status_enum WHEN 'DRAFT' THEN '草稿' WHEN 'PENDING_APPROVAL' THEN '待审批' WHEN 'APPROVAL' THEN '审核中' WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN '已审批' WHEN 'AGREE' THEN '已通过' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '已驳回' WHEN 'REJECT' THEN '已驳回' WHEN 'WITHDRAWN' THEN '已撤回' WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN '已完成' ELSE t.status_enum END AS statusDesc, t.purpose_location_id AS warehouseId, o.name AS warehouseName, o.name AS stocktakePharmacy, CASE t.type_enum WHEN 'CABINET_STOCKTAKE' THEN 'WAREHOUSE' WHEN 'PHARMACY_STOCKTAKE' THEN 'PHARMACY' ELSE 'INVENTORY' END AS stocktakeType, IFNULL(SUM(t.total_price), 0) AS totalPrice, SUM(CASE WHEN t.profit_loss_price > 0 THEN t.profit_loss_price ELSE 0 END) AS totalProfitPrice, SUM(CASE WHEN t.profit_loss_price < 0 THEN ABS(t.profit_loss_price) ELSE 0 END) AS totalLossPrice, IFNULL(SUM(t.profit_loss_price), 0) AS profitLossPrice, COUNT(*) AS itemCount, t.created_by AS createdBy, creator.name AS createdByName, t.applicant_id AS applicantId, app.name AS applicantName, t.apply_time AS applyTime, t.approver_id AS approverId, appr.name AS approverName, t.approval_time AS approvalTime, t.remake AS remark, MIN(t.created_at) AS createdAt FROM wkf_supply_request t LEFT JOIN adm_organization o ON o.id = t.purpose_location_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_practitioner creator ON creator.id = t.created_by AND creator.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_practitioner app ON app.id = t.applicant_id AND app.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_practitioner appr ON appr.id = t.approver_id AND appr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.type_enum IN ('INVENTORY_CHECK', 'PHARMACY_STOCKTAKE', 'CABINET_STOCKTAKE') AND (t.bus_no = #{busNo} OR t.id = #{busNo}) GROUP BY t.bus_no, t.status_enum, t.type_enum, t.purpose_location_id, o.name, t.created_by, creator.name, t.applicant_id, app.name, t.apply_time, t.approver_id, appr.name, t.approval_time, t.remake LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id, t.item_id AS itemId, md.name AS itemName, md.name AS drugName, md.total_volume AS specification, md.total_volume AS spec, md.manufacturer_text AS manufacturer, t.lot_number AS lotNumber, (IFNULL(t.total_quantity, 0) - IFNULL(t.item_quantity, 0)) AS bookQuantity, t.total_quantity AS totalQuantity, t.item_quantity AS itemQuantity, t.unit_code AS unitCode, t.price AS price, t.total_price AS totalPrice, t.profit_loss_price AS profitLossPrice, t.remake AS remark FROM wkf_supply_request t LEFT JOIN med_medication_definition md ON md.id = t.item_id AND md.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.bus_no = #{busNo} AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.type_enum IN ('INVENTORY_CHECK', 'PHARMACY_STOCKTAKE', 'CABINET_STOCKTAKE') ORDER BY t.id ASC

SELECT id, tenant_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted, deleted_at, deleted_by, version, bus_no, original_bus_no, type_enum, status_enum, category_enum, intent_enum, priority_enum, summary_id, deliver_id, patient_id, item_table, item_quantity, total_quantity, item_id, unit_code, occurrence_time, practitioner_id, supplier_id, reason, source_type_enum, source_location_id, purpose_type_enum, purpose_location_id, approver_id, approval_time, applicant_id, apply_time, start_time, end_time, lot_number, trace_no, price, total_price, remake, profit_loss_price FROM wkf_supply_request WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND type_enum IN ('INVENTORY_CHECK', 'PHARMACY_STOCKTAKE', 'CABINET_STOCKTAKE') AND bus_no = #{busNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM adm_organization WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (id = #{warehouse} OR name = #{warehouse}) LIMIT 1
SELECT stock_unit_code FROM med_medication_definition WHERE id = #{itemId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wkf_supply_request WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND type_enum IN ('INVENTORY_CHECK', 'PHARMACY_STOCKTAKE', 'CABINET_STOCKTAKE') AND bus_no = #{busNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE wkf_supply_request SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, updated_at = #{deletedAt}, updated_by = #{deletedBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE bus_no = #{busNo} AND is_deleted = 0 AND type_enum IN ('INVENTORY_CHECK', 'PHARMACY_STOCKTAKE', 'CABINET_STOCKTAKE')
